title: Flow builder: on-canvas validation badges + a Problems panel
body:
## Problem

Flow validation surfaces as a **top text banner** ("This metadata does not match the spec — N error(s)", e.g. `Type: Invalid input`) that does **not** point to the offending node / edge. In a non-trivial flow you can't tell *which* element is wrong. Meanwhile the simulator's `validateFlowDraft` already detects structural problems (no resolvable entry, unreachable nodes, a decision with no default branch, duplicate node ids, dangling edges) — they're just not shown on the canvas.

## Proposal

Render **error / warning badges directly on the offending node or edge** (icon + tooltip with the message), plus a **Problems panel** listing every issue with click-to-navigate (selects and scrolls to the node/edge). Sources: `validateFlowDraft` (structural) + the server `_diagnostics` already attached to the draft.

This is how every serious flow tool (Salesforce Flow, Power Automate) surfaces problems; here the detection mostly exists already — it's a **surfacing** gap.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Per-node / per-edge badge on each element that has an issue, with a tooltip of the message.
- [ ] A Problems panel listing all issues; clicking one selects + reveals the element.
- [ ] Covers the existing `validateFlowDraft` checks and the server `_diagnostics` entries.
- [ ] Clears as issues are resolved.

## Pointers

- `previews/simulator/flow-sim-validate.ts` — `validateFlowDraft()` (entry resolution, reachability, decision defaults, duplicates).
- `previews/FlowCanvas.tsx` — node/edge rendering (where badges attach).
- Server `_diagnostics` on the draft — today shown only in the banner and as `JsonSourceEditor` squigglies.
